about_p1: I grew up in Lofoten and took a slightly winding road to electronics: sports studies in upper secondary school, then a preparatory science course, then a bachelor in electronic systems design at NTNU. I think that road is why I am good at explaining. I remember well what it is like not to understand it yet.
about_p2: Alongside my studies I have been a class representative, sat on reference groups and taken on leadership roles. I like making things run smoothly for others, whether it is a course, a training group or a church service.
about_p3: I speak Norwegian, English and Arabic, and have a connection to the Arabic language and Iraqi culture.
step2_d: Analog electronics, filter design, radio communication
contact_text: I am looking for a summer job in 2027 within electronics and embedded systems. Feel free to reach out if you have something on your mind.
